property_summary: renounceRole may only revoke a role from the caller's own account: it must revert whenever callerConfirmation != msg.sender; the mutant revokes (succeeds) for arbitrary third-party accounts, e.g. when an EOA renounces DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for a different address.
change_summary: Remove the revert check that requires callerConfirmation == _msgSender(), so any account can renounce a role for another address.
